name: Stanovjas' legendoj
source:
A century of shame and hatred, bloody battles and betrayal. It is in these difficult times that your story begins under the reliable vaults of an ancient fortress - the fate of a young mercenary from the Assassins guild. And your life is completely changed after the execution of one mysterious contract to kill: you against your will receive a particle of the power of an ancient demon.
How will you manage your power? Will you save the world from the coming destruction or plunge it into even greater chaos?
translation:
百年的羞耻与仇恨、血腥战斗与背叛。在这些艰难岁月里，你的故事始于古老堡垒可靠的穹顶下：你是一名刺客公会的年轻佣兵。在执行一项神秘的刺杀契约后，你违背意愿地获得了古代恶魔的一部分力量，人生彻底改变。

你将如何运用这份力量？拯救世界免于即将到来的毁灭，还是把世界拖入更大的混乱？
